# pve_ceph_cmd_safety (Data Source)

Heuristical Ceph safety check for a destructive action (stop/destroy) on one service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph_cmd_safety" "example" {
action = "stop"
item_id = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
service = "osd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Action to check One of: `stop`, `destroy`.
- `item_id` (String) ID of the service
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `service` (String) Service type One of: `osd`, `mon`, `mds`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `safe` (Boolean) True if Ceph reports the requested action is safe.
- `status` (String) Human-readable status message from Ceph (typically the reason an action is not safe); absent when Ceph returned no message.
